title: The just-released M6 Mac mini is already on sale for $949
content:
Macworld

Apple Mac mini M6

View Deal

These days, getting a new Mac is more expensive than ever. But right now, Apple’s M6 Mac mini is on sale for $949 right now, which is quite a bit under its $1,099 price tag. That’s quite the discount for a product that’s only been around for a short while.

Besides the incredible M6 processor and the ability to boost your productivity by adding multiple monitors, you should know the new Mac mini also has 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. The M6’s new design includes a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, so Siri AI and graphical-intensive apps will be equally speedy.

The beautiful thing about the new M6 Mac mini is that it tucks under your monitor and gives you your desk back. Even better, it lets you build the exact setup you need because it features three Thunderbolt 4 ports on the back, as well as an HDMI and a 2.5Gb Ethernet port. That makes it possible to have a three-monitor workstation to help tackle your daily workload.

We’ll admit that a similarly specced M4 model would have cost $799 just a couple of months ago, but this is the new reality. So go ahead and grab this tiny powerhouse for $949 while you can still get it for $150 off.
